@pytest.mark.unit
def test_write_escalation_artifact_creates_file():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        base_dir = Path(tmpdir)
        path = write_escalation_artifact(
            task_id="task-123",
            contract_path="/path/to/contract.yaml",
            self_check_summary="Self check passed",
            verifier_summary="Verifier failed",
            disagreement_details="A and B disagree",
            recommended_action="Review manually",
            base_dir=base_dir
        )
        
        assert path.exists()
        assert path.name == "escalation.yaml"
        assert path.parent.name == "task-task-123"
        
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            content = yaml.safe_load(f)
            
        assert content["task_id"] == "task-123"
        assert content["contract_path"] == "/path/to/contract.yaml"
        assert content["self_check_result"] == "Self check passed"
        assert content["verifier_result"] == "Verifier failed"
        assert content["disagreement_summary"] == "A and B disagree"
        assert content["recommended_action"] == "Review manually"

def test_write_escalation_artifact_default_base_dir():
    # This test is tricky because it writes to CWD. 
    # We can't easily mock CWD without fixtures/mocking.
    # However, the rule says "No fixtures". 
    # We can change CWD using os.chdir in the test body, which is allowed as it's standard library.
    original_cwd = os.getcwd()
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            os.chdir(tmpdir)
            path = write_escalation_artifact(
                task_id="task-456",
                contract_path="/path/to/contract.yaml",
                self_check_summary="Self check passed",
                verifier_summary="Verifier failed",
                disagreement_details="A and B disagree",
                recommended_action="Review manually"
            )
            
            expected_path = Path(".onex_state") / "evidence" / "task-task-456" / "escalation.yaml"
            assert path == expected_path
            assert path.exists()
    finally:
        os.chdir(original_cwd)
